subject: Community Onramp credit boost request
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah@craftedlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Community Onramp credit pool request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Hope you’re both well — quick ask from our side. We’re running a 6-week "Community Onramp" program starting July 6 for new community managers who will trial Redwood in small groups. We’d like to offer a small promo pool to cover experiments (chat, embeddings) for ~50 participants so they can kick the tires without hitting paywalls.

Request: 5,000 credits to split across the cohort (roughly 100 credits per person). We’re happy to attach a roster and a short summary of how credits will be used. Is there a straightforward promo code or bulk allocation you can provision?

Timing is tight — we’ll need codes live by July 3.

Attached: onramp_roster.csv (names + emails), draft terms (promo_terms.pdf).

Thanks — let me know what info you need.

Best,
Sarah Miller
Senior Partnerships, Crafted Labs

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah@craftedlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community Onramp credit pool request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the details and for attaching the roster. Quick clarifying questions so we can move fast:

- Use case split: do you expect more embedding workloads (high token usage for indexing) or generation/chat (many short requests)?
- Will participants be creating public content tied to Crafted Labs that we should flag for moderation?
- Do you need unique codes per user or a single pool code for the group?

Marissa: can you confirm whether 5k credits fits the usual promotional band for a first-time cohort from a partner like Crafted? If this looks appropriate, I’ll escalate for final sign-off so ops can provision by July 3.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Sarah Miller <sarah@craftedlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community Onramp credit pool request

Thanks Sarah — good context. Based on the roster and typical onramp behavior, we generally see a mix leaning ~60% embedding (indexing community posts) and 40% chat/generation for experiments. 5,000 credits sounds reasonable but want to propose a small changeset to reduce risk and make tracking easier: 

- Provision a single pool code ("CL-ONRAMP-2026") limited to 5,000 credits and expiry 60 days after issuance.
- Add a short attribution tag in their onboarding so we can track activated users back to the cohort (we can do this via a custom query param in the signup flow).
- Add a clause in the promo_terms.pdf to prevent resale or mass transfer — we already flagged a short paragraph.

If Irene / Aditya approve, I can create the HubSpot promo record and open the provisioning ticket with Ops. Suggested approval note to finance: this is a partner-first community program with high expansion potential; we will treat this as a marketing/promotions expense (HS-83472).

Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Miller <sarah@craftedlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community Onramp credit pool request — APPROVED

Thanks for pulling this together. I’ve reviewed the use case and Marissa’s mitigation plan — approving the 5,000-credit pool with the following conditions:

1) Single pool code (CL-ONRAMP-2026), expiry 60 days after issuance.
2) Limit redemptions to roster emails attached (onramp_roster.csv) for the first 72 hours after issuance; after that we can relax to open redemption for the remainder of the window if usage remains low.
3) Marketing should add the attribution query param for tracking (Marissa please add to the HubSpot record).

Marissa — please create the HubSpot promo entry and open an ops ticket with the attachments (promo_terms.pdf + roster). Ops: provision the pool and confirm when the code is live (target July 3 EOD).

Sarah — happy to partner on a short post-program conversion offer if the cohort has strong engagement.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
